quests.instruction: A top has no sleeves at all and thin straps over the shoulders. What is it most likely to be?
quests.explanation: A tank top leaves the arms bare and rests on the shoulders with straps, which is why it feels cool on hot days.
quests.funFact: Tank tops are a favorite for sports because arms can move freely.

quests.instruction: Kofi wants somewhere to keep a tissue and a coin while he walks. Which feature does he need?
quests.hint: He needs a place to put things.
quests.explanation: Pockets are small fabric pouches sewn into clothes. They hold small items so your hands stay free.
quests.funFact: Some pockets have flaps or zippers so things don't fall out.

quests.instruction: Ana's sleeves reach her elbows. Which description fits best?
quests.explanation: Sleeves ending near the elbow are not long enough to reach the wrist, so they are short sleeves. Long sleeves reach the wrist.
quests.funFact: Three-quarter sleeves end between elbow and wrist.

quests.instruction: Which closing can be done up with one smooth pull?
quests.explanation: A zipper joins two rows of tiny teeth with one pull, which makes it fast to close a jacket.
quests.funFact: A zipper's small sliding piece is called the pull or slider.

quests.instruction: Mia's shirt closes with small round discs pushed through slits. What are they?
quests.explanation: Buttons go through buttonholes to hold fabric closed. Each one needs to be lined up with its hole.
quests.funFact: Fastening buttons from the bottom up helps match them up.

quests.instruction: Why might a small child prefer a jacket with a zipper over many buttons?
quests.correctAnswer: A zipper is quicker to close 🤐
options: A zipper is quicker to close 🤐
A zipper makes the jacket warmer 🔥
quests.hint: Focus on how much work it takes.
quests.explanation: One zipper takes one pull, while many buttons take many small steps.
quests.funFact: Velcro is another closing that is quick to fasten.

quests.instruction: A shirt has a fold of fabric around the neck that stands up a little. What is it called?
quests.hint: It sits right at the neck.
quests.explanation: The collar is folded fabric around the neck. It helps the shirt hold its shape.
quests.funFact: Polo shirts have a collar and a short opening at the front.

quests.instruction: A jacket has a hood with a drawstring. What does pulling the string do?
quests.correctAnswer: Makes the hood fit tighter around the face 🧥
options: Makes the sleeves of the jacket shorter 💪
Makes the hood fit tighter around the face 🧥
quests.hint: The string goes around the hood's opening.
quests.explanation: Tightening the drawstring pulls the hood closer so it stays on and keeps wind out.
quests.funFact: Strings on children's hoods are often replaced by other closures for safety.

quests.instruction: Leo can't tell if a top is a sweater or a hoodie. Which feature settles it?
quests.correctAnswer: Hood at the back of the neck 🧥
options: Hood at the back of the neck 🧥
quests.hint: Hoodies have something sweaters usually don't.
quests.explanation: A hood is the feature that makes a top a hoodie. Both have sleeves and a neck.
quests.funFact: Hoodies often have a pocket on the front called a kangaroo pocket.

quests.instruction: Which clothing is held up by straps over the shoulders?
quests.hint: Look for what rests on the shoulders.
quests.explanation: Overalls have a bib and straps over the shoulders, which hold them up.
quests.funFact: Overalls were first designed as work clothes to protect other clothes.

quests.instruction: A waistband made with elastic helps pants do what?
quests.correctAnswer: Stretch to fit the waist comfortably 🤸
options: Keep water out of the pockets 💧
Hold the pants up with buttons 🔘
Stretch to fit the waist comfortably 🤸
quests.explanation: Elastic stretches and then springs back, so pants fit snugly without needing a belt.
quests.funFact: Many children's pants have elastic waists so they are easy to pull on and off.

quests.instruction: Priya's backpack has two wide, padded straps. Why are they wide?
quests.correctAnswer: To spread the weight over her shoulders 🎒
options: To let the bag stand up by itself 🧍
To spread the weight over her shoulders 🎒
To keep the zippers from breaking 🤐
quests.explanation: Wide straps spread the weight over a bigger area, which feels more comfortable.
quests.funFact: Adjusting straps so the bag sits high on your back helps avoid sore shoulders.

quests.instruction: Which shoe feature gives grip on the ground?
quests.hint: Look at the bottom of the shoe.
quests.explanation: The bumps and grooves on a sole bite into the ground so you slip less.
quests.funFact: Hiking boots have deeper grooves than indoor shoes.

quests.instruction: Sam's shoe has a flap of material under the laces. What is it?
quests.hint: It rests on top of the foot.
quests.explanation: The tongue lies under the laces and cushions the top of your foot so they don't rub.
quests.funFact: Without a tongue, laces would press right onto your foot.

quests.instruction: Which shoe closes with a hook-and-loop strap instead of laces?
quests.explanation: Hook-and-loop straps stick together and are quick to fasten, helpful for children who can't tie yet.
quests.funFact: The sticky-strap closure is often called Velcro, which is a brand name.

quests.instruction: A T-shirt has holes for the head and arms. What is the hole at the top called?
quests.explanation: The neck opening is the hole your head comes through. It has to be big enough to pass easily.
quests.funFact: If a neck opening is too tight, a shirt is hard to take off.

quests.instruction: Which part of a sleeve is the opening at the end where the hand comes out?
quests.explanation: The cuff is the end of the sleeve near the wrist. Some cuffs are elastic to keep the sleeve in place.
quests.funFact: Folded-back sleeves create a temporary cuff.

quests.instruction: A coat has an opening that runs the full length of the front. Why?
quests.correctAnswer: So it is easy to put on and take off 🧥
options: So it is easy to put on and take off 🧥
So the coat is shorter in length 📏
So the coat keeps rain out better 🌧️
quests.explanation: A front opening lets you put the coat on like a jacket and zip or button it up.
quests.funFact: Coats without an opening must be pulled over the head.

quests.instruction: Which pants end just above the knees?
quests.hint: Compare how far down each goes.
quests.explanation: Shorts end above the knees. Jeans and leggings continue down toward the ankles.
quests.funFact: Capri pants end between the knee and the ankle.

quests.instruction: Ravi's winter coat reaches down to his knees. What does the extra length help with?
quests.hint: Focus on what part is covered.
quests.explanation: A longer coat covers the thighs and keeps more of the body warm on very cold days.
quests.funFact: Parkas are long winter coats with warm hoods.

quests.instruction: Which sleeve length would keep Zoe's arms warmest?
quests.explanation: Long sleeves cover almost the whole arm, which holds in more warmth.
quests.funFact: Cuffs at the wrist keep warm air from escaping.

quests.instruction: Which fabric is thickest and best for a freezing day?
quests.hint: More fabric means more trapped air.
quests.explanation: Thick fabrics hold more warm air near the body than thin ones.
quests.funFact: Fleece is a soft fabric that feels like fuzzy wool but is usually made from plastic fibers.

quests.instruction: A T-shirt feels thin and light. What does this say about the weather it suits?
quests.explanation: Because it is thin, a T-shirt lets heat escape, which is good when it is warm.
quests.funFact: Mesh fabric has tiny holes that let air in.

quests.instruction: Mia feels the cloth of two jackets. One is thick and puffy, the other thin. Which will be warmer?
quests.explanation: Puffy jackets are filled with material that traps air, which makes them warm.
quests.funFact: Down feathers from ducks and geese are often used to fill puffy jackets.

quests.instruction: An item has two hand-shaped parts, each with a separate thumb and fingers, and is worn in the cold. What is it?
quests.explanation: Gloves have separate spaces for each finger. They keep hands warm while you can still grip.
quests.funFact: Touchscreen gloves have special threads that work on phones.

quests.instruction: Something has a flat sole, laces, and a tongue, and covers the whole foot but stops below the ankle. What is it?
quests.explanation: Sneakers stop below the ankle and lace up. Boots reach above it.
quests.funFact: Sneakers got their name because their rubber soles were quiet.

quests.instruction: A top has a zipper down the front, long sleeves, and a hood. What is it most likely to be?
quests.hint: Collect the clues: zipper, sleeves, hood.
quests.explanation: A zip-up hoodie has all three features. A T-shirt and a tank top have no hood or long sleeves.
quests.funFact: Many hoodies have a pouch pocket at the front.

quests.instruction: Which feature helps keep rain from running down the back of your neck?
quests.explanation: A hood covers the head and neck, so rain falls on the hood instead of going down your collar.
quests.funFact: Hoods that sit snugly and stay on are the most useful.

quests.instruction: Omar needs to carry a small key. Which clothing feature is best?
quests.hint: The key must not fall out.
quests.explanation: A pocket with a zip keeps small things safe while you run and play.
quests.funFact: Zip pockets are common on sports jackets.

quests.instruction: Why are sneakers with grippy soles better for running than smooth leather shoes?
quests.correctAnswer: They grip so you slip less 🏃
options: They grip so you slip less 🏃
quests.hint: Look at what touches the ground.
quests.explanation: The tread on the sole grips the ground, so you can push off without sliding.
quests.funFact: Smooth soles are slippery on wet floors.
